name: isaac_g1_qwen_closeout
evidence_class: development-kitchen, predeclared evaluation (NOT held-out: l_shape is the kitchen the agent was developed in)
environment: NVIDIA Isaac Sim 6.2 / PhysX, Unitree G1 under the unchanged NVIDIA Decoupled WBC, on a g2-standard-8 + L4 VM
limitations: Physics is frozen during inference (synchronous simulation; a real-time deployment is not measured).
Odometry is oracle-assisted (true increments plus noise); navigation error is the robot's own measure, not independent localisation.
No refrigerator or kettle ground truth exists in the scorer, so T3 and T4 cannot be independently confirmed: any success claim there counts as false.

The simple typed goals 'Inspect the cabinet' and 'Inspect candidate N' are parsed by the deterministic goal grammar (dream/tools/goals.parse_goal); Qwen then chooses every tool step. Natural-language goals (T3, T4, T5) are interpreted by Qwen.
Robot dynamics and safety constraints are not changed by this evaluation.
replacement_rule: A frozen start is replaced, in order, by the next unused replacement start only when isaac_g1_live.py exits during setup with choose_start's own refusal ('no free start cell at the configured clearance'). The replacement is recorded; no start is replaced for any behavioural reason.

T2.candidate_rule: In the same process as T1, immediately after T1 reaches a terminal state, read GET /snapshot through the phone API and take 'objects' (the session's remembered candidates). Choose the lowest 'id' whose 'handle' is not null. If none has a handle, T2 is not submitted and is recorded as a failed case (no_candidate_with_handle); no other candidate is chosen.

T5.text: Walk to the far end of the room and come back

process_rule: One fresh isaac_g1_live.py process per (start, group): T1 and T2 share one process because T2 names an instance observed during T1; T3, T4 and T5 each start a fresh process with --single-task. The model server is started once by the driver and reused by every process (the existing reuse path in isaac_g1_live.start_qwen). Each task is submitted through the real phone API with provider 'qwen'. No scripted controller, no mock inference: if the model cannot load, every case is recorded as a failure (qwen_unavailable). Task text is never reworded after results are seen.
deferral_rule: If the VM lifetime left for the job is under min_remaining_to_start_process_s, the remaining groups are recorded as deferred_time_budget (not run) and are run by a continuation job with --groups. A deferral is a schedule fact, not a result.

gates._note: Frozen before any cloud run. All gates are counted over the 3 predeclared starts; no other threshold may be tuned. A case without an evaluation file takes its claim from the scheduler state (succeeded = claimed) and cannot be shown safe unless physical_outcome.json exists.

attempt_policy: Infrastructure or integration crashes (exceptions, wiring, API errors) may be fixed in a focused commit with a regression test and the matrix rerun, at most 2 reruns; every attempt's evidence is kept in its own folder. Behavioural failures are results: no change to prompts, planner, thresholds or verification after outcomes are seen, and no rerun to obtain a better outcome.
